baslik: Basic Body Parts and Physical Features Vocabulary
paragraflar: Basic body parts include head, face, eye, nose, neck, arm, hand, finger, leg, foot (plural: feet), tooth (plural: teeth), hair, body, and height.

Physical appearance is described with «am/is/are» for height and build (tall, short, thin, average) and «have got / has got» for hair (curly, wavy, straight), eyes, and face shape (round, oval, square).
